description: This PHP source file defines a class CommonMarkConverter which extends a base Markdown converter class. It customizes the environment with additional extensions and renderers to support features like table of contents, headings, code blocks, images, links, and admonitions, specifically tailored for Confluence content formatting within the Daux documentation tool.

classes.name: CommonMarkConverter
classes.description: A specialized converter class that extends the base Markdown converter to include Confluence-specific extensions, such as table of contents and customized renderers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the configuration for table of contents positioning and heading permalink fragments, then calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: extendEnvironment
methods.description: Extends the CommonMark environment by adding table of contents, heading permalink, and various renderers for different node types, including code blocks, images, links, and admonition blocks.
